Hi Katie,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great conversation and really helpful context on Acme's ingestion pipelines and latency targets. As discussed, the next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra teams so we can:

- Walk through the end-to-end inference architecture you currently have
- Align on latency/throughput SLOs and data residency/PII rules
- Surface quantization/compatibility constraints and any performance trade-offs
- Plan a proof-of-concept timeline and success criteria

I've attached a brief proposed agenda (Proposed_Agenda_Technical_Deep_Dive_v1.pdf) and a short Redwood technical overview (Redwood_Technical_Overview.pptx) for context.

Would you be able to confirm who from your side should attend (ML lead + infra/ops + SRE/security)? For timing, we're available next week for a 60–90 min slot — proposed windows below:

- Tue 11/09: 9:00–11:00 AM PT or 2:00–4:30 PM PT
- Wed 11/10: 10:00 AM–12:00 PM PT or 3:00 PM–5:00 PM PT
- Thu 11/11: 9:30 AM–12:00 PM PT

If those don't work, feel free to drop availability or here is my calendar link: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/45

Next steps from our side: Camila (SE) and Dylan (Solutions Eng) will join to cover architecture and performance tuning.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Marissa

Redwood Inference

Thanks, Katie — great summary.

We can definitely include a dedicated 15–20 minute segment on data handling and PII best practices (redaction, in-flight encryption, key rotation). We'll also cover SAML 2.0 and SCIM provisioning as part of the identity/integration section — short checklist to validate ahead of time.

To be concrete, we'd propose the following tightened 90-min agenda:
1) 10 min — introductions & success criteria
2) 20 min — current infra & data flow (Acme)
3) 25 min — Redwood architecture deep dive (runtime, batching, caching, quantized model support)
4) 15 min — security & identity (SAML/SCIM, KMS/HSM, audit logs)
5) 10 min — next steps & PoC plan + timeline

Suggested confirmed slot: Wed 11/10 10:30–12:00 PT — that aligns with our SE calendar. If that works for your team we'll send a calendar invite and a Zoom link.

Camila
